backs.note: Accepted 2026-11-15, built 2026-11-16 (phase 2). Every strip has a back, stitched in a child's large uneven hand in red wool. Each spread has two legal lines: Mabel's ritual on the front and Ruth's on the back. A back fits any slot; Ruth numbered her strips with her own strokes, and her line is read from the other side of the page, so her order runs right to left. Time on a back is time not spent on spread 6. The fourteen marks are the art's glyph-back-01 to glyph-back-14. The lines of spreads 1 and 3 are written for the game and playable in the web build; spreads 2, 4, 5 and 6 are drafts for the author, and the whole selvage sentence is settled with The Page (phase 3).

lines.reads: I am seven still. I play.
When the hunger plays, company stays, and I am warm.
When company goes I am cold, and Mother cuts again.
Unpick the seven; cut while Mother is still; I go home.
I go cold. The play stays still. Company goes home.
